outcome: Lead concentration in umbilical cord blood
cohort: The study included 87 mother-baby pairs from whom cord blood lead samples were collected in Casablanca, Morocco.
finding: The median umbilical cord blood lead concentration was 4.902 ug/dl, with a high proportion of newborns (65.52%) having levels above the CDC allowable threshold, and these levels were significantly associated with maternal educational level, anemia history, delivery mode, passive smoking during pregnancy, and frequency of tea consumption.
mod_finding: Cord blood lead levels were significantly associated with delivery mode.
